name: naijaverse
description: NaijaVerse — a persistent multiplayer Nigerian life-simulation game. Milestone 01: the multiplayer vertical slice.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm --workspace @naijaverse/game-server run build && npm --workspace @naijaverse/web run build
